summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing share repurchases. On June 8, 2026, the company repurchased 2,626,700 A ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of HKD 57.09, increasing treasury shares to 29,577,728. These on-market buybacks reduce outstanding shares and return capital to shareholders. The disclosure reflects routine compliance with HKEX Rule 13.25A. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a capital return via open-market repurchase; watch for continuation of buyback program and impact on share count.
